section_title: Basic pitched-roof envelopes for certain districts - R3/R4 series enumeration and 25/35 ft caps

The pitched-roof district ENUMERATION (which districts this envelope governs), the 25 ft perimeter-wall / 35 ft ridge caps, the building-type applicability (single- or two-family detached / semi-detached / zero lot line), and the sloping-plane setback geometry MUST be confirmed by a qualified zoning professional (G6) before any rule citing this snapshot is published or Verified.

verbatim_excerpt:
R1 R2 R3A R3X R3-1 R3-2 R4 R4-1 R4A R5A

In the districts indicated, the height and setback regulations for single- or two-family detached, semi-detached, or zero lot line buildings or other structures, where permitted, shall be set forth in this Section.

Perimeter walls are subject to setback regulations at a maximum height above the base plane of 25 feet.

Above these heights, sloping planes control the maximum height of the building or other structure requiring either a setback or a pitched roof. These planes start at the maximum permitted height of the perimeter walls and meet at a ridge line of 35 feet above the base plane.

district_enumeration.anchor: 23-421 opening district list (first line of the section body)
district_enumeration.note: The section applies ONE uniform pitched-roof envelope (25 ft perimeter wall / 35 ft ridge, both above the base plane) to every district in this single enumerated list, for single- or two-family detached / semi-detached / zero-lot-line buildings 'where permitted'. The R3/R4-series members recorded here are R3A, R3X, R3-1, R3-2, R4, R4-1, R4A (R1/R2 are group labels - the subject of open blocker B-023 and out of M4-T014 scope; R5A belongs to the accepted M4-T006 R5 pilot). R4B does NOT appear in this section (it is flat-only under 23-422) - the asymmetry is recorded, not symmetrized.

notes: Governs the pitched-roof envelope for the enumerated R1-R5A districts: perimeter-wall height max 25 ft above the base plane; ridge/building height max 35 ft above the base plane. The two caps are SEPARATE typed constraints. Applicability is conditional on building type (single- or two-family detached / semi-detached / zero-lot-line per 23-421).

The setback above the perimeter wall is governed by sloping-plane (pitched-roof) geometry beyond the point where this snapshot's verbatim_excerpt stops. This HTML curl capture channel could NOT render every 23-421 paragraph: the zr.planning.nyc.gov HTML render is documented to lose Section 23-421(g) in text extraction on both official mirrors across four attempts (docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md lines 48-51, owner-verified 2026-09-13), and this capture's excerpt deliberately stops before the sloping-plane construction paragraphs. The 'apex-point, <=80-degree pitch' detail and the '(a) through (g)' paragraph lettering are NOT read from this capture; they are attributed to the preserved rules-engineer agent memory (.claude/agent-memory/rules-engineer/zr-r1-r2-height-setback-source-facts.md, captured live via a different extraction path and preserved in blocker B-023) and to the owner-verified record in docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md - never asserted as content read by THIS capture. The sloping-plane setback remains an A2 gap (D-045-R008) surfaced as a documented limitation, never reduced to a number here; per owner directive, full-text (print/PDF) proof of 23-421 section completeness is still owed before any rule citing this snapshot advances toward G6 (recorded in the M4-T012 packet).

The R1/R2 5-ft reference-plane special provision (23-421 paragraph (g)) is OUT OF THIS CAPTURE'S REACH: this HTML curl channel could not render paragraph (g) (docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md lines 48-51, owner-verified 2026-09-13: 'the zr site's HTML render loses Section 23-421(g) in text extraction' on both official mirrors across four attempts), and the figures 9,500 / five feet / (g) do not appear anywhere in this snapshot's verbatim_excerpt. The provision's existence and trigger conditions are known ONLY from named sources OUTSIDE this capture - the owner-verified record in docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md (section A1/A3, approx. lines 40-56 and 88-90) and the preserved rules-engineer agent memory (.claude/agent-memory/rules-engineer/zr-r1-r2-height-setback-source-facts.md, preserved in blocker B-023) - never as content read by THIS capture. Per those owner-verified-elsewhere sources: for R1 and R2 Districts WITHOUT a letter suffix, the reference plane may be located up to 5 ft above the base plane where EITHER (a) the zoning lot has an area of at least 9,500 sq ft AND a width of at least 100 ft, OR (b) the lot has a slope (measured from the street-wall-line level to the rear-wall-line level) of at least 5 percent. This provision does NOT touch the R3/R4 series and is out of M4-T014 scope (R1/R2 = blocker B-023); it is recorded here only for completeness of the shared 23-421 enumeration and is NOT a value read by this snapshot's capture channel.
